name: Rondel
author: Erin Carter
description: Concentric beveled rings broken into arcs that rotate against one another — each band a raised ring with lit and shadowed edges, segments counter-spinning ring to ring around an off-centre hub. Bold, kinetic, machined.

params.label: Ring count
params.effect: How many rings run out from the centre; low is bold and wide, high a fine target.

params.label: Bevel
params.effect: Width of the chamfer on each ring; low is a flat band, high a rounded torus.

params.label: Segments
params.effect: How finely the rings break into arcs; 0 leaves full rings, high chops them into many segments.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Rotation speed of the arcs; adjacent rings counter-rotate. 0 holds them still.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer offsets the ring centre; 0 ignores the mouse.
